readme_description: This is a binary classification task in which the model must determine if a contractual clause falls under the category of "Change Of Control".
base_prompt_preamble: Does the clause give one party the right to terminate or is consent or notice required of the counterparty if such party undergoes a change of control, such as a merger, stock sale, transfer of all or substantially all of its assets or business, or assignment by operation of law?
